title: GitHub Review by greptile-apps[bot]
summary: **Review Summary:** The reviewer identified 4 issues: (1) `CreateImmutableConfigMap` leaks stale ConfigMaps on every config change since old hash-suffixed ConfigMaps are never cleaned up — add label-based listing and deletion of superseded ConfigMaps. (2-3) `EnsureDeployment` and `EnsureService` both silently drop `Annotations` from the caller-supplied spec in their mutate functions — add `spec.Annotations` propagation alongside `Labels`. (4) `RunJob` inconsistently mutates the caller's `desired` parameter via `SetControllerReference` instead of working on a `DeepCopy()` like every other similar function in the PR.

code_comments.author: greptile-apps[bot]
code_comments.resolution: Resolved: Added three managed labels (labelManagedBy, labelConfigOwner, labelConfigBaseName) to each created ConfigMap and introduced a deleteStaleConfigMaps function that lists ConfigMaps matching those labels and deletes any whose name differs from the current hashed name. Three new tests cover label assignment, stale deletion on data change, and non-interference with different base names.

code_comments.body:
**Annotations silently dropped from desired Deployment**

The mutate function copies `Labels` and `Spec` from the caller-supplied `spec`, but does not propagate `Annotations`. Any annotations set on the desired Deployment — for example Prometheus scraping hints (`prometheus.io/scrape: "true"`), ArgoCD wave annotations (`argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave`), or custom reconciler markers — will be silently ignored on both creation and subsequent updates.

```suggestion
		deploy.Labels = spec.Labels
		deploy.Annotations = spec.Annotations
		deploy.Spec = spec.Spec
```
